description: This file contains utility functions for geometric transformations such as rotation, translation, shear, scaling, flipping, and applying these transformations to axis-aligned bounding boxes in the context of image augmentation for object detection tasks. It provides methods to generate random transformations and to alter the origin of transformations, facilitating augmentation pipelines in computer vision models.

methods.name: colvec(*args)
methods.description: Creates a numpy array representing a column vector from input arguments.

methods.name: transform_aabb(transform, aabb)
methods.description: Applies a geometric transformation to an axis-aligned bounding box, returning the transformed bounding box as a list.

methods.name: rotation(angle)
methods.description: Constructs a 2D homogeneous rotation matrix for a given angle in radians.

methods.name: random_rotation(min, max, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG)
methods.description: Creates a random rotation matrix with an angle uniformly sampled between min and max radians.

methods.name: translation(translation)
methods.description: Constructs a 2D homogeneous translation matrix from a translation vector.

methods.name: random_translation(min, max, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG)
methods.description: Creates a translation matrix with translation components randomly sampled between min and max vectors.

methods.name: shear(angle)
methods.description: Constructs a 2D shear matrix for a given shear angle in radians.

methods.name: random_shear(min, max, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG)
methods.description: Creates a shear matrix with shear angle randomly sampled between min and max radians.

methods.name: scaling(factor)
methods.description: Constructs a 2D scaling matrix for given scaling factors.

methods.name: random_scaling(min, max, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG)
methods.description: Creates a scaling matrix with scale factors randomly sampled between min and max vectors.

methods.name: random_flip(flip_x_chance, flip_y_chance, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG)
methods.description: Constructs a transformation matrix that randomly flips along X and Y axes based on specified probabilities.

methods.name: change_transform_origin(transform, center)
methods.description: Adjusts a transformation matrix to change its origin to a specified point.

methods.name: random_transform( min_rotation=0, max_rotation=0, min_translation=(0, 0), max_translation=(0, 0), min_shear=0, max_shear=0, min_scaling=(1, 1), max_scaling=(1, 1), flip_x_chance=0, flip_y_chance=0, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG )
methods.description: Creates a composite random transformation matrix combining rotation, translation, shear, scaling, and flips, based on specified parameters.

methods.name: random_transform_generator(prng=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a generator that yields infinitely many random transformation matrices, using a dedicated PRNG.

ctags.name: random_transform
ctags.signature: ( min_rotation=0, max_rotation=0, min_translation=(0, 0), max_translation=(0, 0), min_shear=0, max_shear=0, min_scaling=(1, 1), max_scaling=(1, 1), flip_x_chance=0, flip_y_chance=0, prng=DEFAULT_PRNG )
